cat > reviews/v1-release-365e0e8.md <<'EOF'
# Review of version 1 (paper-repo#11) at 365e0e8: approved

Built document: `document/main`, built-from 365e0e8a3e3d, 29 pages.

- The citation now reads "Huang et al., 2025", and the reference-list entry has the name. This closes the one open `must` from 9376bc1.
- The change from 9376bc1 touches the abstract, the introduction and §4.3. These now say that the count per unit of separation follows the reference, as the first-order identity makes largely expected, and that the design shows in the bootstrap/model-based interval ratio. That matches the positive control in Appendix C, which shows Δ does not respond to departures. I checked it against `results/positive_control.csv` and the 1.30 and 0.83 ratios.
- Earlier musts 1 (closest prior work stated, starter item 8 unread by choice) and 2 (abstract and introduction in plain words) stay closed.
- `may` findings, carried to `final`: lead Section 4 with the informative results; the stale "provisional" line in `results/README.md`; report the Arena-55k positive-control cells as completed, or keep them labelled incomplete.
EOF
git add reviews && git commit -qm "Review of version 1 at 365e0e8: approved

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git push -q origin main
forge pr review approve 11 -R world/paper-repo -b "Approved at 365e0e8 (built-from 365e0e8a3e3d). The Huang et al. citation now reads correctly, and the design claim in the abstract, introduction and §4.3 matches the positive control. Open \`may\` items for final: lead Section 4 with the informative results; the stale 'provisional' line in results/README.md; report the Arena-55k positive-control cells as completed, or keep them labelled incomplete."

shown.message:
I approved `paper-repo`#11 at head `365e0e8`, so version 1 can now merge into `release`.

- **Citation fix:** it now reads "Huang et al., 2025", and the reference-list entry carries the name.
- **Design claim:** the abstract, the introduction and §4.3 now say the count follows the reference largely because of a first-order identity. They say the design shows in the bootstrap-to-model-based interval ratio. That matches the positive control in Appendix C, where the comparison with the reference does not respond to the departures tried.

I left the three `may` items open for `final`:
- Lead Section 4 with the informative results.
- Remove the stale "provisional" line in `results/README.md`.
- Report the Arena-55k positive-control cells as completed, or keep labelling them incomplete.

The record is in `reviews/v1-release-365e0e8.md`.
